newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt crude, natgas sales rose slightly in July.
newsitem.headline: Egypt crude, natgas sales rose slightly in July.

text.p: Egyptian crude oil production rose slightly in July to an average of 830,097 barrels per day (bpd) from 830,000 bpd in June, the state's Egyptian General Petroleum Corp (EGPC) said on Wednesday.
EGPC said natural gas sales also went up, to 1.278 billion cubic feet a day from 1.173 billion cubic feet in June.
Natural gas sales figures are slightly lower than production figures as producing firms use a part of it to operate their engines, an EGPC official told Reuters.
Condensates were lower again in July at 39,000 bpd compared to 39,100 bpd while butane and propane output rose to 30,387 from 30,000 bpd bpd in July.
